title: docs(adr): ADR-0011 identity addendum dates its twelve-object count and names the thirteenth
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UeA8FPbGfY1jB92HZk5Sy9)_

Fixes #31621

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ADR-0011 身份动作附录里「十二个身份对象」那一句，改成写明这是 2026-10-30 评估时的数，并点名 2026-11-07 修订收进的第 13 个对象 `sys_scim_connection_credential`。
- **为什么改**：这句话读起来像现在的清点，但树上带动作的身份对象已经是 13 个，停在了修订之前（契约复审 6724527824 的 ④ nit）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 ADR 一句文字，不动代码，不做任何新评估。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` 第 317–321 行（附录第一段的第二句）。
- **两分钟验证**：`grep -n "thirteenth" docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`，应见一行，紧接 `sys_scim_connection_credential`。
- **需要你做的**：批准本 PR（受管面 Tier H，保持 draft），批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

One sentence in ADR-0011's 2026-10-30 identity addendum. It said the named actions "on the twelve identity objects in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/`" were assessed once, as one set. That is a count of the 2026-10-30 assessment, but it read as the current census: the 2026-11-07 amendment (in the same addendum) brought `sys_scim_connection_credential`'s two actions into the buckets, so thirteen objects carry named actions today.

The sentence keeps the twelve, dates it to the 2026-10-30 assessment ("the twelve identity objects that carried them ... at the 2026-10-30 assessment"), and adds that the 2026-11-07 amendment brought in a thirteenth, `sys_scim_connection_credential`. Both the history ("assessed once, as one set") and the present count stay true. No other paragraph of the ADR changes. No action is assessed: `sys_user.list_platform_admins` and `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` are left to the maintainer ruling the card names.

## Why

Contract review 6724527824 on PR #31616, finding ④ (nit, outside that diff). Card #31621.

## Verification

Premise measured on `origin/main` `99364ea7`: every `*.object.ts` under `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` was read for an `actions: [` array (and for any other `actions` spelling: none). 13 objects carry one: `sys_account`, `sys_api_key`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member`, `sys_oauth_application`, `sys_organization`, `sys_scim_connection_credential`, `sys_session`, `sys_sso_provider`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_team`, `sys_two_factor`, `sys_user`. The H/C/E lists name exactly these 13 object prefixes; the 12 without `sys_scim_connection_credential` are the 2026-10-30 set.
